# VOID REQUIEM

**A complete bullet-heaven arena survival game in ONE HTML file — generated by DeepSeek v4.1 from a single prompt.**

### ▶ [Play it now](https://vyva360-byte.github.io/void-requiem/)

No install, no server, no assets, no network. One file, 3,793 lines, ~154 KB. Open it and survive.

---

## The experiment

This repo is a stress test, not a product. The question: *how far can a single, brutally specific prompt push an AI model?*

The answer turned out to be: **all the way to a finished game.** DeepSeek v4.1 was handed one prompt demanding a full Vampire Survivors-class game — wave director, boss patterns, evolutions, meta progression, object pooling, synthesized audio — with an explicit ban on placeholders, stubs, and TODOs, and an 8-point acceptance checklist it had to verify against its own output.

It delivered the entire game in one shot, then reported its checklist with line numbers. The claims were independently verified against the file: exact line and byte counts, zero external references, zero stub markers, boss stats and difficulty multipliers present in code as specified, and the full 124 KB of game JavaScript parses clean.

- 📜 **[Read the exact prompt that generated this game](PROMPT.md)**
- 🎮 **[The game itself](void-requiem.html)** (also served as the site's `index.html`)

## How to play

- **Move:** WASD or arrow keys (touch: floating virtual joystick). Your weapons fire on their own — your job is positioning, greed, and survival.
- **Collect** XP shards from the fallen. **Level up** and draft 1 of 3 cards: up to **4 weapons + 4 passives**, each capped at level 5.
- **Evolve:** a weapon at level 5 paired with its matching passive can ascend to a golden evolution — six exist.
- **Survive 20 minutes.** Bosses toll at 5:00, 10:00, and 15:00. At 20:00, **THE FINAL BELL** comes for you. Killing it is the only victory.
- **Between runs:** gold funds permanent meta upgrades across six tracks. Death is tuition.

## What's inside

- **6 weapons** with distinct behaviors and level-5 specials, **6 golden evolutions**, **8 passives**
- **7 enemy types** — swarming Husks, darting Skitters, tank Brutes, ranged Spitters, Splitters that burst into Minis, phasing Wraiths — plus timed elite variants
- **4 bosses** with telegraphed, multi-pattern attacks and on-screen HP bars
- **A minute-by-minute wave director** with escalating composition, climaxing in the 13–19 minute "long dark" surge
- **Full game feel:** screen shake, hitstop, damage numbers, crits, streak counter, low-HP vignette — and synthesized WebAudio SFX and ambience (no audio files)
- **Engineered for load:** object pools for enemies, projectiles, particles, and damage numbers; a spatial hash for collisions; canvas-only rendering. Built to hold 60 fps with 300+ live enemies
- **Meta progression** in `localStorage`: gold, upgrade tracks, reroll charges, lifetime stats, resettable save

## Difficulty

| Mode | What changes |
|---|---|
| **CHILL** | Gentler scaling, fewer concurrent enemies — learn the requiem |
| **STANDARD** | The game as written |
| **BRUTAL** | Harder multipliers across HP, damage, spawns, and concurrency |
| **REQUIEM** | The full sentence. You start at 75 HP. Good luck |

Enemy HP, damage, speed, spawn rate, XP, and the concurrent-enemy cap all scale by the table in code — and keep scaling every minute you stay alive.

## Tech notes

- **Zero dependencies.** No `<script src>`, no stylesheets, no fonts, no images, no `fetch`. Everything — sprites, sound, particles — is generated in code at runtime.
- **Single file by design.** View source and you are reading the entire game: CSS, markup, and one inline script.
- Runs in any modern browser, desktop or mobile.
